messages:
Nina (Marketing): Heads-up: we're targeting May 5 for the OSS reference-app public launch. Need: launch post, two 10-min how-to tutorials, a live 45-min webinar (30 demo + 15 q&a), benchmark one-pager, and the inbound routing playbook. Can folks claim items?

Priya (DevRel): I'll own the tutorials and the demo. Demo will show routing + caching + a small quantized model run.

Marco (Content): I'll write the launch post and the one-pager benchmark narrative. Diego, can you supply the latency/cost numbers across hosted vs dedicated by Wed?

Diego (Data): Yep. I'll run the comparisons and send a CSV + TL;DR summary. Expect it by Wed 5pm.

Leah (Ops): For lead flow I'd like: webinar signups -> HubSpot lead with tag "refapp_launch"; if company_size > 200 or sector=gov -> enterprise queue. Otherwise SDR queue. Also add utm_campaign=refapp-may2026 on all promo links.

Nina (Marketing): Good. Also want a simple signup form field for "primary use case" and "team size". That will feed routing rules.

Priya (DevRel): I'll add an ISSUE_TEMPLATE in the repo prompting org size + intended workload. That'll help prioritize community issues.

Marco (Content): Messaging note: focus on "drop-in reference implementation" and "reproducible benchmarks". Avoid marketing superlatives. Include a small code snippet showing the API call and routing config.

Diego (Data): Routing rules I'll propose: if demo_score >=8 and company_size>100 -> AE; demo_score<8 -> SDR. I'll provide the JSON mapping and a tiny webhook example for HubSpot.

webhook-bot: Webhook test received: {"event":"signup","utm":"refapp-may2026"}

Nina (Marketing): Promo plan draft: blog May 5, tutorials May 7, webinar May 14. Promo cadence: announcement, tutorial clip, reminder 5 days, last reminder day-of. We'll run paid and community posts.

Leah (Ops): I'll write the SDR playbook with canned responses and lead-scoring thresholds. Also will add a routing flag for regulatory sectors to go to enterprise AE.

Priya (DevRel): For the webinar demo resource, I'll add a minimal dataset & run instructions under examples/demo. Will include the batching one-liner and a docker-compose for local run.

Marco (Content): I'll ask legal for a short permissions blurb for using benchmark numbers and for the repo license note.

Nina (Marketing): Action list: Marco = launch post + benchmark draft (due Wed); Priya = tutorials + repo PR with demo and templates; Diego = benchmark data + routing JSON; Leah = SDR playbook + HubSpot mapping; Nina = promo calendar + webinar logistics. Check-in Fri for assets. Thanks! :sparkles:
